output.summary: The decline is best explained by the forced move from Castellan Hall to the smaller, distant Brightwater venue. Single-ticket sales fell 45% in the first move year, and lapsed patrons cite travel (41%) far more than programming (11%). Post-1945 share rose while per-concert sales were unchanged (1,034 vs 1,019), and the cathedral's downtown programs sold 1,520 per concert. Core subscribers (3+ scans) renew at 85-86% steadily. The 30% drop is close to the peer median (-29%), though peers' timing differs. Marketing effectiveness is untested because no attribution data exists. Recommend the board's segmented review, a non-renewal decision is not supported, and the cathedral dates and a shuttle should be piloted. Dropping commissions would also jeopardise grant funding.
